Bowling Score Calculator

Bowling Score Calculator — real 10-frame scoring with strikes, spares and 10th-frame bonuses, entered frame by frame.

0
Total score

Real scoring: strikes and spares earn bonus balls; the 10th frame allows up to 3 balls. Pin menus enforce legal values.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter pins for each ball, frame by frame.
  2. Pin limits update automatically (e.g. no 2nd ball after a strike).
  3. Cumulative scores appear as each frame becomes final.
  4. Total updates live — 300 is perfect.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do strike and spare bonuses work?

Strike = 10 plus your next two balls. Spare = 10 plus your next one ball. That's why a strike can be worth up to 30.

How does the 10th frame work?

Strike on the first ball and you get two more balls (pins reset). Spare the first two and you get one bonus ball. Otherwise the frame ends at two balls.

What is a perfect game worth?

A perfect game is 12 strikes = 300. The calculator handles it correctly.
